build_HiViT_backbone: build a HiViT hierarchical vision transformer backbone with specified architecture like tiny, small, base, or large
create_PatchEmbed_layer: create a PatchEmbed layer that splits images into non-overlapping patches with configurable inner patches
build_BlockWithRPE_block: build a BlockWithRPE transformer block with optional relative position embedding and layer scale
create_Attention_with_RPE: create an Attention module with relative position bias table and optional spatial masking support
build_PatchMerge_downsample: build a PatchMerge layer that downsamples patch features by merging 2x2 spatial neighborhoods
